findings.name: V05 staged construction GAP
findings.detail: ACCEPTANCE V05: a 0/1/2/3/4/5 s base/frame/walls/roof/activation clip + mid-build reload resume that charges once. Method: seeded an in-progress warehouse WorldState site through the save envelope (encodeSave 4th arg), booted the real built app, and sampled the staged build two ways — the pure buildingStageReport()/assemblyStageAt() index from persisted progressTicks AND the LIVE three.js scene graph (mesh.visible via the __THREE_DEVTOOLS__ render-wrap seam), cross-checked at every sample, plus the building's in-page 2D backing-store crop hash. ASSEMBLY_STAGES=["base","frame","walls","roof","activation"]. Result: phone: stages [0->1->2->3->4], live==persisted false, distinctStageCrops true, completedOnce true, ledgerConserved true, reloadResume true, reloadSingleCharge true; desktop: stages [0->1->2->3->4], live==persisted false, distinctStageCrops false, completedOnce true, ledgerConserved true, reloadResume true, reloadSingleCharge true. One or more numeric checks FAILED — recorded as a real GAP, not a pass. See the per-check results and samples.
